description: Register a GcsBucketResource (bucket create/delete/ensure-exists) for use by other components -- the Airflow GCSCreateBucketOperator/GCSDeleteBucketOperator equivalent as reusable, injectable logic.

credentials_env_var.label: Credentials Env Var
credentials_env_var.description: Env var holding a path to a GCP service account JSON key file. Unset uses application-default credentials (same convention as gcs_to_database_asset's credentials_env_var).
